purpose: USES Temporarily relieves hot flashes and other symptoms associated with change of life.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN As with all medications, keep out of reach of children.
warnings: STOP USE AND ASK DOCTOR If symptoms persist or recur, discontinue use. If pregnant or nursing, consult a licensed practitioner before using this product.
indications_and_usage: INDICATIONS LACHESIS Sore throat PULSATILLA Weeping SEPIA Indifference SULPHUR Agitation
dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS Directions: Adults and children 12 years and older: 2 pills dissolved under tongue every 4 hours, or as directed by a licensed practitioner. Children 4 years to under 12 years: 1 pill dissolved under tongue every 4 hours, or as directed by a licensed practitioner. Children under 4 years: Consult a licensed practitioner.
